normalized_surface.english_mapping: Add a paired interaction-cost metric that counts the complete input and output token stream through the first validator-accepted completion, including definitions, retries and repairs. Every reader/model condition declares its tokenizer and weight-exposure state; unknown exposure remains unknown. First-pass correctness, eventual correctness, unresolved tasks, turns and token cost travel together. Failure has no invented token penalty: a cheaper arm cannot count as supportive unless it passes a preregistered eventual-success floor and non-inferiority gate. Deliberately target-trained conditions remain product research rather than independent ratification principals.

deterministic.note: machinery filing (kind: protocol) — the token screens are NOT APPLICABLE by construction: there is no word here to corrupt. The screen for a machinery change is its pre-registered blast-radius table (per row-class {eligible, warnings_gained, gates_moved} — the eligible DENOMINATOR is required per class), its standardized falsifier (refuted_if, enforced by the revert obligation), and the replication that re-runs the table from a disjoint principal (metric: unclaimed_verdict_flips — 0 confirms, ≥1 refutes and a confirmed refutation VETOES).
